SELECT 'terrain_sync_diagnostics'::text AS source_system,
    (terrain_sync_diagnostics.id)::text AS source_record_id,
    terrain_sync_diagnostics.id AS diagnostic_id,
    terrain_sync_diagnostics.reference,
    terrain_sync_diagnostics.support_id,
    terrain_sync_diagnostics.utilisateur,
    terrain_sync_diagnostics.device_id,
    COALESCE(terrain_sync_diagnostics.operation, terrain_sync_diagnostics.etape) AS operation,
    terrain_sync_diagnostics.campagne_id,
    terrain_sync_diagnostics.edt_id,
    terrain_sync_diagnostics.statut,
    (terrain_sync_diagnostics.details ->> 'erreur'::text) AS error,
    terrain_sync_diagnostics.attempt,
    terrain_sync_diagnostics.last_attempt_at,
    terrain_sync_diagnostics.resolved_at,
    terrain_sync_diagnostics.resolved_by,
    terrain_sync_diagnostics.resolution,
    terrain_sync_diagnostics.source,
    terrain_sync_diagnostics.created_at
   FROM terrain_sync_diagnostics
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'terrain_operations'::text AS source_system,
    (terrain_operations.id)::text AS source_record_id,
    NULL::uuid AS diagnostic_id,
    terrain_operations.reference,
    terrain_operations.support_id,
    terrain_operations.utilisateur,
    NULL::text AS device_id,
    terrain_operations.type_operation AS operation,
    NULL::bigint AS campagne_id,
    NULL::bigint AS edt_id,
    terrain_operations.statut,
    terrain_operations.erreur AS error,
    1 AS attempt,
    terrain_operations.completed_at AS last_attempt_at,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS resolved_at,
    NULL::uuid AS resolved_by,
    NULL::text AS resolution,
    'terrain_operations'::text AS source,
    terrain_operations.created_at
   FROM terrain_operations;
